description: As the author, save a new plan version (earlier approvals no longer apply) and tell reviewers. Either pass the full revised plan_markdown, or apply a suggestion in one step: thread_id (a reviewer suggestion), suggestion_id (from lake_review_status) or model (run the whole plan on that model). Can also reply to threads and mark them resolved.

addressed_threads.description: Thread ids this revision addresses (marked resolved)

model.description: Run the whole plan on this model, e.g. sonnet

plan_id.description: Plan id (defaults to the active plan)

push.description: Commit only the plan file and push (default on when applying a suggestion)

suggestion_id.description: Apply this Lake suggestion, e.g. models-2-4, cap-12, drop-5

name: lake_submit_revision
